tolerances.name: seeded_reproduction
tolerances.units: percentage points between retained draws of two runs at the same seed
tolerances.rationale: A rerun on one implementation and architecture must return every retained draw unchanged.

tolerances.name: cross_architecture_reproduction
tolerances.units: percentage points between retained draws on two architectures
tolerances.rationale: The recorded amd64 and arm64 runs compare the same retained draws; their maximum floating-point difference sets this separate architecture bound.

tolerances.name: interval_endpoint_precision
tolerances.units: percentage points between the extreme interval endpoints of runs differing only in seed
tolerances.rationale: The Monte Carlo error of a published interval endpoint at 10000 draws per day. It bounds how much of a reported interval is sampling noise rather than estimated uncertainty, and it is measured, never enlarged afterwards.

tolerances.name: coverage_boundary_stability
tolerances.units: percentage points over retained days after moving both support boundaries
tolerances.rationale: The registered 7, 14 and 30 day boundary shifts remain below the frozen support bound for every modeled component.

tolerances.name: probability_monte_carlo_standard_error
tolerances.units: probability at the worst-case 50% event rate
tolerances.rationale: At 10,000 draws the worst-case standard error is 0.005. Inclusive comparisons are checked immediately below, at, and immediately above both 4% support and 175 seats.

tolerances.name: threshold_probability_precision
tolerances.units: probability range over repeated development seeds
tolerances.rationale: Largest repeated-seed range among inclusive 4% probabilities from final-day joint draws.

tolerances.name: majority_probability_precision
tolerances.units: probability range over repeated development seeds
tolerances.rationale: Repeated-seed range of the registered coalition's inclusive 175-seat probability after national modified Sainte-Lague allocation.

tolerances.name: snapshot_drift
tolerances.units: percentage points after an addition/deletion or fixed correction of one source row
tolerances.rationale: The largest corrected-history revision after removing each institute's last eligible development poll, which also measures adding it back, or moving 0.1 points from OTHER to M in that poll.
